subject: Runtime / Platform headcount approval — 2 ICs + compensation bands
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Runtime / Platform headcount approval — 2 ICs + comp bands

Team —

Requesting approval to open two IC roles on Runtime/Platform (senior infra engineer x1 / runtime engineer x1) for Q2 hiring. Quick summary: 

- Headcount: 2 FTEs (open now, hire target by end of Q2)
- Rationale: production capacity bottlenecks on batch eviction and KV cache eviction logic affecting 95p latency during peak. Mateo's team needs two dedicated ICs to decouple runtime optimizations from feature work.
- Proposed bands (attached): Senior Infra Eng = 160-200k base + 30-50k equity; Runtime Engineer (senior) = 150-185k base + 25-40k equity. Total OTE ranges are in the attached PDF.
- Budget ask: existing engineering HC budget covers the base salaries but we need a one-time hiring premium for relocation/market adjustments (details in spreadsheet).

Attachments: headcount_request_Q2_runtime.xlsx, compensation_bands_runtime_platform.pdf, candidate_shortlist_runtime.docx

Asks: 
1) Approve opening — headcount and bands (Markus + Mateo)
2) If approved, authorize offer flex up to +10% above band midpoint for top-tier candidates (Markus sign-off)
3) Loop in Finance (Lisa) if we need an exception to the HC budget for signing bonuses/relocation.

If you want a quick sync, I can do 20m today.

Thanks,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head of Platform & Product Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Runtime / Platform headcount approval — 2 ICs + comp bands

Lauren —

Thanks for the summary and attachments. A few quick questions before I greenlight: 

- Can you confirm the title levels you're proposing? (I see "Senior" — are we pegging at L6/L7 equivalent?)
- What's the expected time-to-productivity estimate? (e.g., 3 months vs 6 months) — important for ramp assumptions in the finance sheet.
- On the +10% offer flex: would that be only at offer approval stage for exceptional candidates or applied proactively on initial offers?

If the bands are within the ranges we already approved in Dec, I'm inclined to approve the openings today. If we need an HC budget exception for relocation/signing we should pull Finance in.

-Markus

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Feb 2026 08:24:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Runtime / Platform headcount approval — 2 ICs + comp bands

Lauren / Markus —

Putting a +1 on both reqs. A couple of data points to support speed: 
- We've had three incidents in the last quarter where cache rehydration caused 95p spikes and required manual intervention; a dedicated runtime engineer would reduce incident MTTR by estimated 30-40%.
- Expected time-to-productivity: 4-5 weeks for infra onboarding, 10-12 weeks to fully own complex kernel/runtime changes.
- For the offer flex: recommend using the flex only on final-stage candidates (post-onsite) and mark it as "approval required" in Greenhouse so we have a clear audit trail.

Also attaching a shortlist from Amelia — two candidates look strong and would likely require near-top-of-band offers.

-Mateo
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Feb 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Runtime / Platform headcount approval — 2 ICs + comp bands

Thanks — approved from my side for both reqs. One operational note: please include "production SLO work" as a primary responsibility in the JD so recruiting can better screen for experience with latency-first systems. Also suggest a probationary 6-month performance checkpoint tied to cost/latency improvement KPIs.

Jonas: can you confirm we have the equipment (2x A100 reserved) in the Dedicated pool for these hires?

-Maya
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Feb 2026 09:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Runtime / Platform headcount approval — 2 ICs + comp bands

Lauren / team —

Confirmed: we can reserve 2x A100s in Dedicated for setup and onboarding for Q2; ops cost will be routed to the Platform cost center as discussed. No blockers on infra.

I'll also ping Infrastructure procurement to ensure we can provision laptops and access in week 1 after offers are accepted.

-Jonas
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Amelia Brooks <amelia@hirefast.co>, Lisa Gomez <lisa.gomez@financepartners.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Feb 2026 15:48:00 -0800
Subject: FINAL: Approve HC open + offer flex policy (runtime / platform)

All —

Thanks for the quick responses. Summary / decisions: 
1) HC open approved for 2 FTEs (Senior Infra Eng x1, Senior Runtime Eng x1).
2) Compensation bands approved as attached.
3) Offer flex up to +10% above band midpoint is allowed only for final-stage candidates and requires Markus's written sign-off per candidate. Recruiter (Amelia) to record approvals in Greenhouse.
4) Jonas confirmed infra availability; Mateo provided ramp estimates.
5) Lisa — please confirm whether we need an explicit budget transfer for relocation/signing above the existing HC bucket. If yes, let us know the approval workflow and ETA.

Amelia: you can proceed to send initial outreach/offers to shortlisted candidates; hold any offers at top-of-band until we have Markus sign-off.

Appended attachments: headcount_request_Q2_runtime.xlsx; compensation_bands_runtime_platform.pdf; candidate_shortlist_runtime.docx

-Lauren

--
Lauren Bishop
Head of Platform & Product Ops
Redwood Inference
